sourceAudits.finding: MiniLM q8, threshold=.35, Top-K=5; embeddings cached by content SHA-256.
Hook injects candidates; agent must decide and call use_skill; recommendation alone is not execution.
Separate load/read resource/run script tools; host-specific SDK injection and execution.
Code inspection only: parallel loop queries nonexistent standard Promise.state; timeout race does not cancel underlying task. Do not copy.
Incremental hash and staleness manifest; default embedded Qdrant locks directory.
Usage/avoid/ask/combine extracts can enrich metadata without loading all bodies.
Escalates low evidence or close/umbrella matches; preserves diagnostics.

interfaces: Node.js SDK with user-provided async selector and executor callbacks
innovationCandidates: 基于任务、资料和工作阶段动态重新选择

design.reuseStrategy: 兼容现有 SKILL.md 和安装器，不建立新 skill 格式/marketplace。核心自己实现小型可复核中间件，借鉴设计并署名。无第三方代码复制。
